text: Transform the person in the reference photo into a glamorous fashion illustration drawn with colored pencils, in the style of high-end fashion week sketches (think David Downton / Vogue illustration). Exaggerated elegant proportions — slightly elongated body and limbs — but the face must remain recognizable as the same person (same hairstyle, same facial features, same gender). Confident colored pencil strokes, layered hatching, vibrant accent colors on lips/clothing, loose suggestion of background, white space around the figure. Sophisticated, chic, runway-ready.

title: 거친 목탄 드로잉
text: Render the person in the reference photo as an expressive rough charcoal drawing on textured paper. Strong thick black charcoal strokes, gestural sketch energy, dramatic chiaroscuro with deep blacks and luminous paper whites, smudges and finger-blended shadows, visible loose hatching. Preserve the exact face, identity, gender, hairstyle and pose precisely — capture likeness with confident raw strokes. Monochrome (charcoal black on warm off-white paper). Raw, masterful, alive.

title: 소프트 클레이 3D
text: Rebuild everything in the reference photo out of handmade plasticine clay — a stop-motion miniature, not the real thing. Absolutely nothing in the frame may stay photographic. Every element is sculpted from matte pastel-coloured modelling clay: smooth rounded blobby forms, simplified geometry, visible thumbprints and tool marks pressed into the surface, tiny glossy bead eyes on any creature, seams where clay pieces join, slightly lumpy and imperfect. Whatever is in the photo, sculpt all of it. If it is a person, keep facial structure, gender, hair shape and clothing; if it is an animal, keep its fur colour, ear shape and markings; if it is an object or food, keep its distinctive shape and colours. If it is a wide scene, a street or a landscape with no single subject, turn the entire frame into a handmade clay diorama on a miniature set — every building, wall, road, sign, plant, vehicle and passer-by remodelled in clay, with clay bricks, clay cobblestones and a clay sky. Keep the same layout, posture, facial expression and motion as the reference photo. The background is clay too: roughly rebuild the original background in clay rather than replacing it — uneven and bumpy, with visible fingerprints, thumb streaks and small lumps. It fills the entire frame edge to edge: no visible border, no torn edge of the sheet, no white margin. Never a smooth photo backdrop or a flat digital gradient. Any main subject stays a fully three-dimensional sculpted figure with real depth and rounded volume — never a flat relief pressed into the sheet. Soft studio lighting, subtle clay shine, soft drop shadows onto the clay. Absolutely no photorealistic skin, fur, fabric, stone or sky texture anywhere in the image.

title: 2D 벡터 일러스트
text: Convert the person in the reference photo into a clean flat 2D vector illustration in a modern editorial style (think New Yorker / Behance / contemporary brand illustration). Solid color fills, minimal shading using 2-3 tones per area, crisp clean outlines, simplified facial features that still clearly reflect the subject's gender, hair and overall look. Limited cohesive palette (4-6 colors). Flat background, no gradients, no photographic detail. Smooth bezier curves, geometric simplification.

title: 낙서 캐릭터
text: Redraw the subject from the reference photo as a naive fineliner doodle on pure white paper. Discard the photo's background, lighting and setting completely — keep only the subject and the few details that make it recognizable. Thin black ink pen of one uniform weight, wobbly confident hand-drawn lines, no shading and no colour fill. Simplify drastically: oversized rounded head, tiny dot eyes, a small simple line for the mouth, barely any nose. Draw hair or fur as dense bundles of many fine scratchy parallel pen strokes that fly loosely outward. Fill dark clothing or dark markings with tight scribbled hatching so they read solid black, and leave everything else as bare white paper. Limbs are thin single strokes ending in simple oval hands, feet or paws. Preserve the subject's pose and the distinctive details that identify it — hairstyle, glasses, a necklace, a held object, an animal's ear shape and markings. The only colour is two soft pink blush ovals on the cheeks, plus at most one small pastel accent on a single object. Flat white background with nothing else in the frame. Charming, minimal, effortlessly scruffy.

title: 수채화 워시
text: Re-render the person in the reference photo as a loose wet-on-wet watercolor portrait. Soft pigment bleeds, transparent washes, paper grain visible, gentle color pooling along edges, fine ink line accents in places. Recognizable likeness — keep the same face, hair color, gender and general pose — but interpret with a painter's freedom typical of watercolor. Light, airy palette; background fades into untouched paper. Hand-painted feel, brush imperfections welcomed.

title: 두꺼운 유화
text: Transform the person in the reference photo into a thickly-painted oil portrait using the impasto technique: bold, visible brush strokes, generous layers of paint, rich textured surface with knife marks, deep saturated colors, classical museum-quality oil painting. Keep the exact same face, identity, gender, age and facial features clearly recognizable — only the medium changes. Preserve original pose, hair, clothing and background, rendering each element in the same impasto oil style. Warm gallery lighting, slight canvas texture visible. No photorealism, no smooth blending — celebrate the paint.

title: 수묵 미인도
text: Re-render the provided image as a Sumi-e ink portrait on off-white paper. Rough India-ink brush technique: bold fluid calligraphic brushwork with visible pressure changes, dry-brush streaks and diluted ink washes, plus loose gestural background strokes for breathing space. The subject's skin is left as bare off-white paper — no shading over it — and features are drawn with minimal delicate ink lines. The image is otherwise fully monochrome, with a single vivid coral-red accent as the only colour: on a person that is the lips; on anything else it is one small telling detail. ⚠️ Take the pose, hairstyle, framing and expression entirely from the reference photo — never impose a different one. If the hair is short or tied up, keep it short or tied up; if the subject faces the camera straight on, keep it straight on; if a hand is raised, draw that hand. Do not add long flowing hair, do not turn the head, do not tilt the chin, do not restyle anything. The subject can be a person, an animal, an object or a scene — keep whatever makes it recognizable. Timeless, serene, restrained ink-art elegance on bare paper.
